items.exampleEn: The neighbors complained about our dog.
I knew from his tone that he was tired.
items.exampleZh: 從他的語氣，我聽得出他很累。

items.exampleEn: Don't shout at the dog. Be nice to it.
items.exampleZh: 不要對那隻狗大叫，要對牠好一點。

items.exampleEn: This book has a long description of the old city.
items.exampleZh: 這本書對那座古城有很長的描寫。

items.exampleEn: Our printer can print in color.
items.exampleZh: 我們的印表機可以印彩色。

items.exampleEn: Thank you for your quick reply.
Online shopping is easy and fast.
items.exampleZh: 網路購物既簡單又快速。

items.sentenceEn: I'm still waiting for a reply from the hotel.

items.audioEn: Please print two copies of this letter before the meeting.
items.audioZh: 請在開會前把這封信印兩份。

items.sentenceEn: Her tone was kind but strong.
We heard a shout from the next street.
items.sentenceZh: 我們聽到隔壁街傳來一聲大叫。

items.stemEn: He told a ____, and everyone laughed.
items.stemZh: 他講了一個笑話，大家都笑了。

items.stemEn: You can buy tickets ____ or at the station.
items.stemZh: 你可以在網路上或在車站買票。

items.passageEn: Last month, Ben ordered a jacket online. The description on the website said it was blue, but the jacket was green. He wrote an email to complain. Two days later, he got a reply. The shop said sorry in a kind tone. They asked him to print a form and send the jacket back with the receipt. His wife made a joke: "Green looks good on you!"
items.passageZh: 上個月，Ben 在網路上訂了一件夾克。網站上的描述說是藍色的，收到的卻是綠色。他寫了一封電子郵件去投訴。兩天後，他收到回覆。店家用親切的語氣道歉，請他印一張表格，把夾克連同收據寄回去。他太太開玩笑說：「你穿綠色很好看啊！」

options: 尺寸太小，他穿起來很不舒服
顏色和網站上的描述不一樣
打電話給客服說明問題
帶著收據到店裡換一件

items.promptZh: 你可以幫我印這一頁嗎？
referenceEn: Can you print this page for me?
Could you print this page for me?
rubricZh: 請求可寫例如 Can you…?、Could you…?

items.instructionZh: 用 complain 造一個句子，說說某人常抱怨什麼。
referenceEn: My brother always complains about his homework.
My grandmother complains when the bus is late.
rubricZh: complain 常接 about＋事物（例如 complain about his homework）
時態配合句意（例如 complains、complained）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似過嚴：「說習慣用現在式（例如 complains）」寫死時態；題目「說說某人常抱怨什麼」也可寫過去習慣（My grandfather always complained about…／used to complain），依已裁原則評分要點不寫死時態，建議改「時態配合句意（例如 complains、complained）」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "時態配合句意（例如 complains、complained）"（原 "說習慣用現在式（例如 complains）"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：正解選項明顯是最長的一個（「印一張表格，把夾克連同收據寄回」15 字 vs 5–6 字），違反「正解不落在最長集合」；應縮短正解或加長干擾項。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 執行長裁示：「單題正解最長」類 issue 由全級長度名次分布規則統一處理
